notablePrerequisites:
Flesh Duplicate on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Flesh Duplicate do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Flesh Duplicate.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Flesh Duplicate.
Activate Flesh Duplicate by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
